description.value: Mount Boucherie Estate Winery is a long-established Okanagan estate winery farming vines since 1968, now anchored by a striking 15,000 sq ft Wine Experience Centre designed by Ciccozzi Architects and opened in 2020. The property combines a daily tasting room, award-winning estate wines across five tiers, and The Modest Butcher Kitchen + Market — a farm-to-table restaurant with full bar service and a rooftop patio overlooking the lake. For a touring cyclist cutting through Okanagan wine country, it offers a full stop with food, wine, and sweeping valley views at the foot of a former volcano.
